description: This file contains implementation of big number multiplication functions, including BN_mul and bn_mul_normal, for cryptographic operations in OpenSSL.

methods.name: BN_mul
methods.description: Performs multiplication of two BIGNUMs with context management, handling special cases and optimizing with conditional compilation.

methods.name: bn_mul_normal
methods.description: Performs the core multiplication of two arrays of BN_ULONGs, used internally by BN_mul.
